intent: Build a class Stack with: push(x) appends x; pop() removes and returns the last item (raise IndexError('empty') if empty); peek() returns the last item without removing it (raise IndexError('empty') if empty); is_empty() returns True iff no items; and __len__ returning the item count. LIFO order.
oracle_test:
from stack import Stack
import pytest


def test_oracle():
    s = Stack()
    assert s.is_empty() and len(s) == 0
    s.push(1); s.push(2)
    assert len(s) == 2 and s.peek() == 2 and not s.is_empty()
    assert s.pop() == 2 and s.pop() == 1 and s.is_empty()
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        s.pop()
    with pytest.raises(IndexError):
        Stack().peek()
